news_cards.title: Bihar Sarkar School me Shaniwar ka Routine Badlega
bullets: Bihar ke schoolon me shaniwar ka routine badlega, sarkar jald jari karegi notification
Is notification me schoolon ke liye naye rules aur guidelines honge
Bihar government school ke liye yeh decision liya gaya hai taaki students ko behtar shiksha mile

news_cards.title: JP Ganga Path ko Milega Vishwashtariya Swaroop
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne JP Ganga path ke vikas ke liye nirdesh diya hai, 65 kilometer ganga channel viksit kiya jayega
Is project ke liye koi vishisht budget nirdharit nahi kiya gaya hai, lekin yeh project Bihar ke liye bahut mahatvapoorn hai
JP Ganga path ke vikas se Bihar ke logon ko bahut fayda hoga, yeh project Bihar ke vikas me mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayega

news_cards.title: Nasha Mukti Abhiyan me MoU Sign Kiya

Nasha mukti abhiyan ke liye brahmakumari sanstha ke saath MoU sign kiya gaya hai, yeh abhiyan Bihar ke vikas me mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayega

news_cards.title: Bihar State Co-Operative Bank ki Karyapranali ko Badhaya
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Bihar state co-operative bank ki karyapranali ko badhane ke liye nirdesh diya hai
Is bank ki karyapranali ko adhik prabhavi, aadhunik aur janonmukhi banane ke liye kai kadam uthaye jayenge
Bihar state co-operative bank ki karyapranali ko badhane se Bihar ke logon ko bahut fayda hoga, yeh bank Bihar ke vikas me mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayega

news_cards.title: Gaya me Ekikrit Ispat Pariyojna ke Liye MoU
bullets: Mukhyamantri ke samne Gaya me ekikrit ispat pariyojna ke liye MoU par hastakshar kiye gaye
Is pariyojna ke liye 6 hazar karod rupe ka nivesh kiya jayega, yeh pariyojna Bihar ke liye bahut mahatvapoorn hai
Gaya me ekikrit ispat pariyojna ke liye MoU par hastakshar karne wale mahashakti group ke saath yeh pariyojna Bihar ke vikas me mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayega
